label: Any VR game: the headset side only (the VR resolution), until the game has a profile of its own
notes: Works for every game because it changes the VR runtime, not the game. SteamVR's resolution is a file; Virtual Desktop's is set in its headset app, so The Optimizer says which step to pick. A game's own menu settings come in a profile of its own (copy this file, add 'ask' settings for its menu, or file settings where the game keeps them).

knobs.label: Virtual Desktop VR graphics quality
knobs.where: the Virtual Desktop app in the headset (Settings, Streaming, VR graphics quality), then restart the game
